brief:
Shehab Wire reported that the University College of Applied Sciences held graduation celebrations despite the ongoing Israeli military operations in Gaza. The ceremony took place in an environment of active warfare, bombardment, and widespread destruction caused by what the college characterized as genocide.

The graduation event was described as extraordinary given the conditions, marking a symbolic continuation of academic life amid the conflict.

title: Gaza college holds graduation ceremony amid war and destruction
